finding.text: t54's live XRPL AI Hub lists transaction 384D9F00...E558AE as a 0.67376 RLUSD batch settlement. The detail page identifies the ledger index as 108,051,936, merchant Heurist Inference Router, facilitator t54 XRPL Facilitator, and settlement type as a single XRPL CheckCash covering all requests in the batch.
finding.implication: A Payment-only counter will miss this CheckCash settlement. Paid requests, session settlements, CheckCreate and CheckCash must be separate series.
finding.limitation: The buyer address is not matched to the earlier 110-wallet cohort; this is evidence of live batch use, not proof of cohort migration.
